information_unit: first prior-only 1.5-sigma Bybit-minus-Binance synchronized funding differential, followed by one completed five-minute Bybit inventory response
funding_alignment: funding rates usable only at recorded settlement timestamps; Binance official monthly fundingRate archives are adjacent-CHECKSUM verified
features: Bybit and Binance funding levels and prior-90-event differential z-score
turnover, volatility and BTC/ETH peer confirmation
event_threshold: absolute prior-only funding differential z-score >= 1.5; frozen before economic outcomes
decision_time: first completed five-minute Bybit response after settlement
execution: first later observable Bybit one-minute open
stop: latest causally right-confirmed opposite five-minute pivot plus fixed 0.25 ATR buffer; fixed 1.5 ATR disaster fallback only when geometry is invalid
exit: stop, completed protected-origin loss, later funding-differential normalization/reversal, or stage-boundary NAV mark; no elapsed-time or scheduled close
funding: exact signed Bybit settlements crossed by the position

chronology.confirmation: 2023 conditional on a positive non-sparse PF>1 and exact-winner-reroute-positive 2022 survivor

stage_boundary: labels and account paths are capped and NAV-marked at the next calendar-year boundary; 2023 is not loaded after the failed 2022 gate
